subject_line: First-level appeal - Raymond Toller - Claim CMH-25-7781203 - MRI lumbar spine (72148)
key_arguments: CG-RAD-12 Indication B1 waives the 6-week conservative therapy requirement for a progressive neurological deficit.
Serial exams document new left EHL (5/5 to 4/5) and dorsiflexion (5/5 to 4+/5) weakness between {{VISIT1}} and {{VISIT2}}.
The physical therapist independently documented new heel-walk difficulty.
The MRI found a 9 mm L4-5 extrusion compressing the left L5 root, concordant with the deficit, and was ordered to plan intervention.
